title: Selection and Mechanism Study of Q-Markers for Xanthocerais lignum Anti-Rheumatoid Arthritis Based on Serum Spectrum-Effect Correlation Analysis.
authors: Qian, Hao; Su, Lei; Yang, Yaqiong; Tian, Xiangyang; Dai, Qingge; Meng, Fantao; Wang, Xiaoqin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药黄栌治疗类风湿关节炎的血清谱效关联与Q-Marker筛选，仅用分子对接预测化合物-靶点作用，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To elucidate the chemical profile of Xanthocerais lignum's extracts of different polarities and their impact on rheumatoid arthritis (RA), we identified anti-RA markers and predicted their action mechanisms. METHODS: A collagen-induced arthritis rat model was established, and UPLC-Q-Exactive Orbitrap MS technology was employed to analyze and identify the chemical constituents within the alcohol extract of Xanthocerais lignum and its various extraction fractions, as well as their translocation into the bloodstream. Serum spectrum-effect correlation analysis was utilized to elucidate the pharmacodynamic material basis of Xanthocerais lignum against RA and to screen for Q-Markers. Finally, the potential anti-RA mechanisms of the Q-Markers were predicted through compound-target interaction data and validated using molecular docking techniques. RESULTS: We identified 71 compounds, with flavan-3-ols and flavanones as key components. Of these, 36 were detected in the bloodstream, including 17 original and 19 metabolized forms. Proanthocyanidin A2, dihydroquercetin, catechin, and epicatechin (plus glucuronides) showed potential anti-RA activity. These compounds, acting as Q-Markers, may modulate ERK, NF-kappaB, HIF-1alpha, and VEGF in the HIF-1 pathway. CONCLUSIONS: This research clarifies Xanthocerais lignum's pharmacodynamic material basis against RA, identifies 4 Q-Markers, and offers insights into their mechanisms, aiding quality assessment and lead compound development for RA treatment.
abstract_zh: 目的：为阐明黄栌木不同极性提取物的化学成分及其对类风湿关节炎（RA）的影响，我们鉴定了抗RA标志物并预测了其作用机制。方法：建立胶原诱导的关节炎大鼠模型，采用UPLC-Q-Exactive Orbitrap MS技术分析并鉴定黄栌木醇提物及其各萃取部位中的化学成分，以及它们在血液中的转运情况。利用血清谱效关联分析阐明黄栌木抗RA的药效物质基础，并筛选Q-Markers。最后，通过化合物-靶点相互作用数据预测Q-Markers的潜在抗RA机制，并使用分子对接技术进行验证。结果：我们鉴定出71种化合物，其中黄烷-3-醇和黄烷酮为关键成分。其中，36种在血液中检测到，包括17种原型和19种代谢形式。原花青素A2、二氢槲皮素、儿茶素和表儿茶素（及其葡萄糖醛酸结合物）显示出潜在的抗RA活性。这些化合物作为Q-Markers，可能调节HIF-1通路中的ERK、NF-kappaB、HIF-1alpha和VEGF。结论：本研究阐明了黄栌木抗RA的药效物质基础，鉴定出4种Q-Markers，并提供了其机制见解，有助于RA治疗的质量评估和先导化合物开发。
